name: Jules
tagline: Google's asynchronous coding agent that works in cloud VMs and opens pull requests.
description: Jules is Google's asynchronous coding agent. It clones repositories into cloud virtual machines, proposes a plan for approval, makes changes, and opens pull requests. It is used through a web app, a REST API, and a command-line tool.

pricing.notes: Free tier with 15 tasks/day; higher limits through Google AI Pro and Ultra plans.
